solutions.check: grid rebuilt from the blog's light list (unique); every answer written into it with each crossing agreeing

clue.text: Is unable to get a glass for fruit

parts.note: is unable means can't, written without the apostrophe
a loupe is a jeweller's magnifying glass

explanation.surface: Someone who cannot get hold of a drinking glass for their fruit.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Glass' suggests a tumbler, but here it is a magnifying lens, the jeweller's LOUPE.
explanation.definitionFit: A cantaloupe is a variety of melon, so it is an example of fruit.

clue.text: Trainee meets one in the country

parts.note: a cub is a novice or trainee, as in a cub reporter
a means one, as in a single thing

explanation.surface: A trainee is introduced to someone out in the countryside.
explanation.definitionFit: Cuba is a Caribbean island nation, so it is an example of a country.

clue.text: It's bread whichever way you look at it

indicators.text: whichever way you look at it
indicators.note: reading forwards or backwards gives the same word, so the bread's name is a palindrome

parts.note: these definition words give the whole answer, and the answer is itself the palindrome: it reads the same from either end

explanation.surface: An insistence that something is bread from any angle.
explanation.definitionFit: Naan is a flat leavened loaf from South Asian cooking, an example of bread.

clue.text: Ambitious and venomous reptile — one that's intelligent

parts.note: an asp is a venomous snake of Egypt
I is the Roman numeral for one
rational means able to reason, intelligent

explanation.surface: A snake described as both ambitious and clever.
explanation.definitionFit: An aspirational person has aspirations, high hopes of success, which is to be ambitious.

clue.text: Honour with a hard form of sorcery

parts.note: the OBE (Order of the British Empire) is a British honour
H is the abbreviation for hard, as on pencils

explanation.surface: An honour combined with some tough kind of magic.
explanation.definitionFit: Obeah is a folk magic practised in the Caribbean, a kind of witchcraft.

clue.text: English ship initially getting into accident? Use force!

indicators.note: getting into means these letters go inside the word for accident

parts.note: prang is British slang for a minor crash
SS is the abbreviation for steamship

indicators.note: initially picks the opening letter of the word that follows it

explanation.surface: An English ship in a collision prompts a call for strong measures.
explanation.definitionFit: To press-gang is to coerce someone into doing something, as navies once forced men to serve.

clue.text: Boy and girl lied

parts.note: a son is a boy
G is a standard abbreviation for girl

explanation.surface: A boy and a girl both told untruths.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Lied' reads as the past tense of lie, but it is the German word for an art song.
explanation.definitionFit: A lied is a German art song for voice and piano, so it is a kind of musical piece.

clue.text: Alien in public dance is lacking restraint

parts.note: overt means open, done in public

indicators.note: in means the alien goes inside the word for dance

parts.note: a hop is an informal dance
ET is the film alien, the extra-terrestrial

explanation.surface: An alien dancing publicly with no inhibitions.
explanation.definitionFit: Over-the-top describes something excessive or exaggerated, with no restraint.

clue.text: Sergei ends disorder of gluttony

indicators.note: putting the letters into disorder means rearranging them

explanation.surface: Sergei puts a stop to an eating problem.
explanation.definitionFit: Gluttony is excessive appetite for food, a form of greed.

clue.text: Amber helps reformed profaner

indicators.note: reformed means formed again, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A woman named Amber helps a sinner change his ways.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone who speaks irreverently of sacred things is a profaner, guilty of blasphemy.

clue.text: Tory leader in charge of function

indicators.note: in means the leading letter sits inside the word for charge

parts.note: a fee is a charge for a service

indicators.note: leader picks the first letter of the word before it

explanation.surface: The head of the Conservatives is running some event.
explanation.definitionFit: A fete is an outdoor fundraising event, a social function.

clue.text: Bob produces arty design

indicators.note: a design here is a new arrangement of the letters

explanation.surface: Someone called Bob turns out artistic designs.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Bob' looks like a name but is the verb meaning to bow or curtsy quickly.
explanation.definitionFit: To bob is to make a short curtsy, so the phrase for a curtsy is a synonym.

clue.text: Gold casket marked and scored

parts.note: or is the heraldic term for gold
a chest is a box or casket
rated means assessed, marked

explanation.surface: A golden box was assessed and graded.
explanation.definitionFit: Orchestrated means arranged for an orchestra, which is to have scored the music.

clue.text: Special eating place, commonly shabbier, for building worker

parts.note: caff is the colloquial British word for a cheap café
older things tend to be more worn, shabbier

explanation.surface: A rather run-down café used by a builder.
explanation.definitionFit: A scaffolder erects scaffolding on construction sites, so is a building worker.

clue.text: Teachers' recipe — it promises to be wholesome

parts.note: NUT was the National Union of Teachers in Britain
R is short for recipe, from Latin recipe on prescriptions
IOUs are written promises to pay

explanation.surface: A teachers' recipe guarantees healthy food.
explanation.definitionFit: Nutritious food provides nourishment, so it is wholesome.

clue.text: Coat that's excellent with one class of animals

parts.note: a crust is a hard outer coat or layer
ace means excellent
a means one, a single thing

explanation.surface: A superb coat paired with a particular group of creatures.
explanation.definitionFit: Crustacea is the zoological group of crabs, lobsters and shrimps, a class of animals.

clue.text: Accountant put spirit in stock for stew

parts.note: CA is a chartered accountant

indicators.note: in means the spirit goes inside the word for stock

parts.note: stock and set both mean standard, as in a stock or set phrase
the soul is a person's spirit

explanation.surface: An accountant adds alcohol to stock to make a stew.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Spirit' and 'stock' suggest liquor and broth in a kitchen; they are SOUL and SET.
explanation.definitionFit: Cassoulet is a slow-cooked French dish of beans and meat, an example of a stew.

clue.text: Dress up when about to be introduced to writer

indicators.note: being introduced to the writer means going inside the word for writer

parts.note: a pen is a writing instrument
re means about, concerning

explanation.surface: Someone smartening up just before meeting an author.
explanation.definitionFit: To preen is to groom oneself carefully, to smarten or dress up.

clue.text: Almost let slip and do without

indicators.note: almost means the final letter of the word is not reached

parts.note: to forget is to let slip from memory, so let slip means forgot

explanation.surface: Someone nearly gave away a secret and chose to go without.
explanation.definitionFit: To forgo something is to give it up or abstain from it.

clue.text: Weaken a club with debts? That's wise?

parts.note: to sag is to droop or weaken
C is the abbreviation for clubs in cards
IOUs are notes acknowledging debts

explanation.surface: Is it sensible to undermine a sports club with heavy debts?
explanation.definitionFit: Sagacious means having sound judgement, which is to be wise.

clue.text: Put one over on unpopular fellow's work

parts.note: out means out of fashion, unpopular
a man is a fellow; the possessive just joins the pieces
oeuvre is French for a work, an artist's output

explanation.surface: Deceiving a disliked man about his creative output.
explanation.definitionFit: To put one over on someone is to outwit them, gaining an advantage by clever moves.

clue.text: Awfully cruel medical condition

indicators.note: awfully suggests the letters are badly mangled into a new order

explanation.surface: A painful illness that is terribly harsh.
explanation.definitionFit: An ulcer is an open sore on skin or a membrane, a medical complaint.

clue.text: Be sure — run and see

parts.note: R is the cricket abbreviation for run
a see is a bishop's diocese; Ely is a cathedral city in Cambridgeshire

explanation.surface: Make certain: go quickly and look.
explanation.walkthrough: 'See' looks like a verb; it is a bishop's diocese, here Ely.
explanation.definitionFit: To rely on something is to depend on it, to be sure of it.

clue.text: Vegetable commonly found in Christmas pudding

indicators.note: found in means the letters sit inside the words that follow

explanation.surface: A vegetable often discovered inside the festive dessert.
explanation.definitionFit: Spud is the informal word for a potato, a vegetable in everyday speech.

clue.text: Cross over the threshold

indicators.note: over signals the word for cross is turned over, read backwards

parts.note: a rood is a cross or crucifix, as in a church rood screen

explanation.surface: An instruction to step into a building.
explanation.walkthrough: The clue reads as a cryptic definition of stepping in, but over turns ROOD round.
explanation.definitionFit: The threshold is used loosely for the entrance itself, the hinged panel at the doorway of a room.

clue.text: Ne'er-do-well boycotts Dickensian clerk

parts.note: to black goods or a firm is to boycott them, in union usage
Uriah Heep is the scheming clerk in Dickens's David Copperfield

explanation.surface: A rogue shuns a clerk from a Dickens novel.
explanation.definitionFit: The black sheep of a family is its disreputable member, a good-for-nothing.

clue.text: Impulsive soldier's quiet

parts.note: RA is the Royal Artillery, standing for a gunner or soldier; the possessive just joins
sh is the call for quiet

explanation.surface: A hot-headed soldier who is unusually silent.
explanation.definitionFit: Rash means acting hastily without thought, being impulsive.

clue.text: Yesterday, troubled about Romeo being quixotic

indicators.note: about means the troubled letters go around the extra letter
troubled means disturbed, so the letters are rearranged

parts.note: Romeo is R in the NATO phonetic alphabet

explanation.surface: Romeo, troubled about yesterday, is lovelorn and idealistic.
explanation.walkthrough: 'troubled' rearranges YESTERDAY, and 'about' puts that around R to give STAR-RYEYED.
explanation.definitionFit: Quixotic, from Don Quixote, means unrealistically idealistic, which is to be dreamy and naive.
